The '''Caretaker of the Lost Souls''' was a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] user who was an unwilling follower of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]].

==Biography==
Before becoming an unwilling follower of Exar Kun, the Caretaker of Lost Souls was a student at [[Corellia University/Legends|Corellia University]], and may have been a member of an archeological expedition on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] that unknowingly tunneled into the tombs below the [[Temple of Exar Kun]] and released the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] spirit. The evil spirit proceeded to bind the students and researchers to his will, and induct them into the [[Cult of Exar Kun]]. Afterward, he sent them to [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], to the [[Corellia University research outpost]] they had originally come from to enslave the rest of the people there. The majority of them were then sent back to Yavin 4. After losing contact with the outpost and fearing the worst, [[Cornelius Wagglehorn|Professor Cornelius Wagglehorn]] hired a group of spacers to travel to Talus and investigate.

After arriving at the research outpost and discovering what had happened, the spacers informed the professor. He sent them the location of the tomb and implored them to travel there and destroy the malevolent spirit. The Caretaker was the third major enemy the spacers faced within the tomb, having previously defeated the [[Open Hand of Hate]] and the [[Minder of Weak Wills]]. Once she noticed the group, the Caretaker sealed the chamber and sent her minions after them, three at a time. During the battle, a few of the Caretaker's prisoners, fellow students who had yet to succumb to Exar Kun's will, managed to assist in weakening the Caretaker, until she was forced to take matters into her own hands. She surrounded the room in a thick green fog and proceeded to deliver bolts of [[Force lightning/Legends|force lightning]] to the bodies of the spacers from the middle of the room, while shielding herself from any direct melee attacks. After a long and arduous battle, with the spacers trying desperately to both escape the fog and kill the woman electrocuting them, the spacers stood triumphant over the Caretaker's corpse, her spirit finally free of Kun's wretched grasp. The spacers then continued on through the tomb, until they met the [[Clenched Fist of Hate]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Caretaker_of_the_Lost_Souls_SWG.png|thumb|right|200px|The Caretaker of the Lost Souls in ''Star Wars Galaxies'']]
The Caretaker of the Lost Souls was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:EK" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Caretaker of the Lost Souls was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Exar Kun|"Exar Kun" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:EK" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|"Chapter 9" update]], on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>

The Caretaker of the Lost Souls was a "boss" enemy NPC in the Temple of Exar Kun. She is the third encounter in the instance, coming after the Open Hand of Hate and the Minder of Weak Wills.<ref name="SWG:EK" />
